note: Black Hills NF campground in the Bear Lodge Mountains, about 20 mi N of Sundance by US-14 and forest roads 838, 843 and 842. B Loop sits under ponderosa pine on a hillside west of Cook Lake; picnic sites, a fishing pier and a shoreline trail are on the water. Generators 6 am-10 pm. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-10-07) + rec.gov 231835: only B Loop (15 sites, 19-33, 38-60 ft) is open - Loop A and the lake trail closed by a landslide. Reservable mid-May to Sep 30 (180 days, 2-day cutoff), first-come at $15 Oct - Dec 15; $28 peak. Lakeview -> not waterfront: B Loop is ~140 m+ from the lake under continuous pine. Pin ~360 m NE at the dam -> move. Phone empty -> (307) 283-1361.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview -> not waterfront: on a 660-m Esri frame the only open loop (B, sites 19-33) sits on a forested hillside west of the lake; the nearest sites (23, 24, 26 around 44.5943,-104.4110) are ~140 m from the shore under continuous ponderosa canopy. The FS says 'The campground sits on a hillside above the lake, while picnic areas line the shoreline'. rec.gov's 'Some sites ... open up to views overlooking the lake' likely describes the closed loops; nothing verifiable from B Loop.
PIN MOVE (~360 m): stored 44.59550,-104.40750 is east of the dam at the lake's north end. B Loop centroid / FS point 44.5945096,-104.4118458. Suggested pin 44.5945,-104.4118.
SITE COUNT: stored 33 (whole campground, from the note) -> 15 now operating (B Loop; rec.gov lists only these). Stored max_rig_ft 48 -> 60 (rec.gov per-site maximum, site 028).
